jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished landscape concept-art sheet for Echoes of the Broken Sun, realistic painted hard-surface/mineral science-fiction RTS production design. Large elevated 45-degree tactical three-quarter base view occupying 75% of sheet; below it a narrow strip of three closeup infrastructure details. Warm light parchment presentation background, dark crisp technical labels, refined hand-painted geometry, readable silhouette, soft natural daylight, restrained emission. Not a screenshot, no game HUD. Present a SMALL functional settlement with only four principal buildings and generous clear unit movement lanes, foundations joined into the surrounding dusty alien ground, not four disconnected object portraits. Infrastructure should visibly terminate at building sockets rather than float or pass through geometry. Use reference images as building identity references, not as layouts to copy. Title large upper left, small footer 'SETTLEMENT CONNECTION STUDY — CANDIDATE'. New layout and infrastructure are proposals, preserve recognizable existing architecture. No enclosing forcefield bubble or territorial border. No cinematic bloom obscuring the connections. Clear flow and negative space between buildings. Title 'MERIDIAN COMPACT — BASIC BASE'. References 1 Anchor squat white ceramic circular drum with tall central service mast and three front worker bays; 2 Power Link tall rectangular pillar with FOUR stacked panels and cyan collar, 2couplings4conduits; 3 Array Foundry elongated open longitudinal fabrication hall, opposed end ramps. Layout: Anchor rear-left; one Power Link central-left; Array Foundry right, exit facing open foreground; small Aegis Post foreground-right is a three-legged stationary ceramic turret with two emitters, no pillbox. Power Link must be distinctly much smaller than Anchor. White ceramic panels over charcoal frames, modest brass service marks, cyan energy. Draw the engineered network explicitly: paired thick dark physical conduits from Anchor rear-side socket to Power Link coupling, branch at a small flush junction to Foundry side socket and Aegis base. Run conduits along service-lane edges, with recessed covered crossings where necessary; keep building entrances and production exit open. Cyan narrow inserts and sparse traveling pulse marks indicate powered connections; physical pipes remain dark and solid. Modest modular concrete/ceramic service pads and maintenance tracks establish faction presence without paving entire area. Label each building with fine leader lines. Bottom three detailed insets labeled 'POWERED CONNECTION', 'OFFLINE — CONDUIT REMAINS', 'COVERED ROUTE CROSSING': first exact socket/pipes glowing narrowly; second same pipes/collar dark; third flush cover over two buried pipes with unobstructed path above. Add short note 'Illustrative routing — gameplay graph governs power'. Do not invent generators, extra vehicles, or new buildings.

correction_prompts.prompt: Precise local edit of this settlement sheet. Preserve the entire layout, all buildings, all captions, framing, colors and main image exactly. Change ONLY the bottom CENTER inset labeled OFFLINE — CONDUIT REMAINS: remove ALL cyan/blue luminous inserts and glow from BOTH physical conduits and the endpoint collar in that inset, replacing with unlit neutral dark charcoal gray inserts. Physical pipes/collars remain visible and intact. All other insets and main base remain cyan-powered unchanged. This must show no energy emission whatsoever in the offline inset. No other changes.

Precise corrective edit of this settlement concept sheet. Preserve layout, architecture style, all four buildings' positions, ground, bottom insets and overall composition. Three targeted corrections only: 1 change the top-left Concordance role label [PRODUCTION] to [CORE]. 2 Concordance must have exactly SIX PAIRS of dark vertical panes, twelve individual panes total arranged around the ring with one broad front entry gap. Current ring has too many pairs; simplify to SIX distinctly readable pairs at approximately evenly spaced angular locations, retain paired slightly offset slabs, same general ring diameter, height language and empty center. 3 make the very thin magenta cosmetic connection coming from the left ground junction continue all the way to a tiny socket on the Phase Anchor BASE, crossing the thin circular field line WITHOUT joining or branching from the circle. Ring remains independent circle around the single spire, not a cable. All other elements unchanged.
